statement: The Federal Open Market Committee will announce a lower federal funds target range at the conclusion of its September 15-16, 2026 meeting than the range set in July 2026.
resolution: TRUE if the Federal Reserve statement released 2026-09-16 sets a federal funds target range below the range set after the July 2026 meeting; FALSE if held or raised.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range announced 2026-09-16 is equal to or higher than the range set after the July 2026 meeting.
